scope: Read-only receipt audit; public finite observations, not proof, admission or rewards

baseline.binding: current public299 input/token/output hashes and counts equal both historical public299 and historical proxy native records

hash_checks.parser_sources: recomputed from frozen local source bytes and bound to run spec/profile/native meta
hash_checks.input_token_output: cross-checked across native rounds, profile records and historical baseline receipts
hash_checks.limit: Raw corpus/token/compressed streams are absent here; their content SHA256 values cannot be independently recomputed from histograms. Output hashes are verified for receipt consistency, not regenerated.

summary.remaining: Fresh frontier scoring at the measured time coordinate is required; no earlier fixed threshold is assumed. Small byte savings alone do not establish useful frontier margin. Formal proof/axioms still required; a non-STOP status is not a gate verdict.
